claim_summary: CRAFTER is a feedback-driven forecasting workflow that mines frozen-forecaster residuals with compositional search and LLM feature proposals, applies a source-blind validation gate, and selects a post-hoc corrector.

claim_evidence.quote: C RAFTER mines the residual with two generators of different character. A compositional search composes the raw channels into new features, and an LLM names mechanisms the raw schema does not contain. Both feed candidates into the single gate of §3.3, which decides what survives.

modules.name: Residual compositional feature search
modules.scope_reason: TSK because the search reward and candidate selection target the unexplained forecasting residual and validation error; changing the task family would require a different feature objective and reward. It is not GTS because temporal handling is subordinate to the forecasting correction objective.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - forecasting-specific objective or validation criterion

evidence.quote: searches. It uses a Monte-Carlo tree search (Kocsis and Szepesvári, 2006) whose nodes are UCB1 bandits (Auer et al., 2002).

modules.name: LLM feature proposal roles
modules.scope_reason: TSK because the planner, specifier, base proposer, and reflection procedure produces feature specifications for time-series forecasting from residual and coverage feedback; changing the task family changes the requested features and objective. It is not GTS because the temporal state is used within a forecasting-specific correction procedure.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - forecasting-specific objective or validation criterion

evidence.quote: LLM-proposed features. The search only recombines existing channels; the LLM invents features that name mechanisms the schema lacks. Organized into roles and queried a few times per

modules.name: Source-blind residual acceptance gate
modules.scope_reason: TSK because acceptance is defined by forecasting validation residual correlation, non-collinearity, and feature budgets; changing the task family requires a different validation criterion and verifier. It is not GTS because the gate validates task-specific correction candidates.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - forecasting-specific objective or validation criterion

evidence.quote: two pipelines. A candidate is accepted only if it explains validation error the corrector cannot already account for: the Spearman correlation between the candidate and the unexplained validation residual must exceed a threshold τ ,

modules.name: Validation-selected post-hoc corrector
modules.scope_reason: TSK because the corrector adjusts a forecast and selects among heads by forecasting validation wMAPE; changing the task family changes the output, objective, and validation criterion. It is not GTS because it is a task-specific forecast correction procedure.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - forecasting-specific objective or validation criterion

evidence.quote: The features that pass the gate feed a corrector. C RAFTER fits a small corrector set—an identity (N ONE) map plus an additive and a multiplicative gradient-boosted corrector—and keeps the one with the best validation wMAPE.
